allocationTime: a provisional file is allocated outside every date folder when a queued job starts processing

finalLayout.dateSource: the published output file's own Windows CreationTime interpreted in the companion's local timezone
finalLayout.publication: after the adapter publishes a regular file, read that file's CreationTime and perform a same-volume no-replace atomic finalize into its date folder
finalLayout.durablePath: a running job does not expose the provisional path; only the completed job records the final path
finalLayout.invalidCreationTime: fail closed and report the bounded error without guessing a date

existingOutputMigration.scope: only the trees rooted at the direct Upscaled, Photorealized, Edited, and Videos folders below the configured output root; accept flat files or one YYYY-MM-DD level and report other layouts
existingOutputMigration.order: plan from each real file's CreationTime, atomically move every planned file, then remap durable output and source references in one locked write
existingOutputMigration.precondition: the queue is paused and no job is running
existingOutputMigration.proof: retain a bounded plan, pre-migration jobs snapshot, receipt, file and byte totals, reference digest, and remaining-move count
existingOutputMigration.invalidCreationTime: report separately and leave the file and references unchanged

existingJobs: recorded absolute output paths remain authoritative and are never rewritten by a settings change; only the explicit paused-and-drained CreationTime migration may remap them after all planned file moves succeed

settingsMutation.write: sibling temporary file with write-through flush, then replace
settingsMutation.environmentOverride: read-only in the application settings surface
